outcome: Ureaplasma species DNA load in amniotic fluid
cohort: The study included singleton pregnancy patients with preterm premature rupture of membranes (PPROM) between 22+0 and 33+6 weeks of gestation, either with intra-amniotic infection or without intra-amniotic inflammation/microbial invasion, who maintained pregnancy for at least 7 days after diagnosis.
finding: Amniotic fluid IL-6 levels significantly decreased 7 days after antimicrobial administration in patients with PPROM and intra-amniotic infection, with a greater decrease observed in those treated with SBT/ABPC and AZM compared to ABPC and AZM or clarithromycin.
